body.statement:
If the independently specified oracle-instance is operationally feasible, then \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}\) is attained by the lexicographically first canonical sparse certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\).  An exact algorithm makes at most \(2^{|\mathcal A|}\) distinct oracle queries and runs in
\[
 2^{O(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+\min\{M,2^{|\mathcal A|}\})}
 \operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+N_{\mathcal O})
\]
time.  It outputs \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\), including its protocol masks, exact literal masks, source masks, \(q_M\)-bit singleton branch indices, and finite transcripts, with \(N_{E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}}\leq B_{\mathrm{sw}}\).  The same incidence table yields an \(H_M\)-approximate accepted certificate, where \(H_M=\sum_{r=1}^{M}r^{-1}\), in \(2^{O(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|)}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+N_{\mathcal O})\) time.  All queried support payloads are charged by \(N_{\mathcal O}\); the result optimizes the operational acceptance predicate and makes no semantic completeness or scalar-evaluation claim.
body.justification: The theorem retains exact cost optimization over the sound switching class and charges every source-law and support access.
body.gap: Ordinary intervention design and fixed-source identification do not optimize branch-indexed SELECT--RAND--CTF-RAND--READ acquisitions.
body.consumer: Counterfactual structural causal bandits can compare exact attainable reward-law acquisition costs.
body.proof_tex:
Operational feasibility and Lemma~\(\mathrm{Sparse\ canonical\ certificate\ bound}\) give a nonempty finite set of canonical accepted certificates of length at most \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\); exact binary-rational costs attain their minimum there.  Its lexicographically first minimizer is \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\), and the same lemma gives
\[
 N_{E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}}\leq B_{\mathrm{sw}}.
 \tag{18}
\]

Theorem~\(\mathrm{Switching\ weighted\mbox{-}cover\ frontier}\) constructs the complete relation \(K_{\mathrm{sw}}(S)\) with at most \(2^{|\mathcal A|}\) oracle queries and proves that its minimum-weight cover value equals \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}\).  Its branch-mask recurrence or protocol-subset enumeration therefore computes the exact value in
\[
 2^{O(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+\min\{M,2^{|\mathcal A|}\})}
 \operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+N_{\mathcal O})
 \tag{19}
\]
time.  All rational sums are compared exactly because their summands are binary rationals.

To recover the stipulated lexicographically first certificate without enumerating all strings of length \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\), retain during incidence construction the finite ordered list of successful witnesses for every pair \((S,\alpha)\).  Given a proposed encoding prefix, delete witness records incompatible with that prefix and force every record already fixed by it.  The cover recurrence (or the protocol-subset enumerator) then decides whether an accepted completion of total cost \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}\) exists: the uncovered universe is the set of unforced branch indices, and a protocol covers exactly those remaining branches for which a compatible successful witness remains.  Trying the next bit in increasing order preserves the invariant that the current prefix has an optimum completion.  At the first complete string the result is optimal; if a lexicographically smaller optimum existed, its first differing bit would have passed the same completion test.  This self-reduction performs a polynomial number of exact-cover calls in the explicit incidence and output length.  By \(M\leq k2^{|\mathrm{LIT}|}\) and (18), that polynomial factor is absorbed in (19).

Decoding the resulting sparse records outputs the protocol and literal masks, labelled source masks, \(q_M\)-bit singleton indices, and canonical transcripts.  The incidence construction caches the reply for each protocol mask, so every issued query and every read support or handle bit is counted once in \(N_{\mathcal O}\).  The greedy conclusion and its faster running time are exactly (17) and (14) of the weighted-cover theorem.  Finally, both the optimization identity and the verifier are stated solely in terms of \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}\); no semantic completeness, scalar functional evaluation, or positivity of an unused cell has entered the proof.
